notes: Input-buffer playback is now available in the AU, VST3, and standalone app, with better exact selection for inputs shorter than 30 seconds.
Standalone BPM controls now share one persistent, editable wheel across the tabs that need it.
The gary4juce audio folder can move out of Documents or onto an external drive, with progress, conflict preservation, and safe fallback.
The standalone app is now included as a regular macOS download alongside AU and VST3.
All three downloads contain universal x86_64/arm64 binaries and license information.
Close your DAW and the standalone app before replacing files with a downloaded update.
